Description: Soil-layer measurements plus profile-level and soil-total observations associated with a plot season with observations lacking an explicit date
Accepts: Soil properties and states, including profile-wide, previous-crop, residue and initial soil data. Store actual measured or derived values, including those selected by configurations. Use this table when no explicit measurement date is known; do not invent a date. Only date_of_measurement controls summary/timeseries routing; date-valued measurement fields do not change the route. Preserve source layers and scope. group_plot_season_ids lists the plot-season contexts sharing the represented data and includes the anchor plot_season_id. Expand shared field or treatment data into a row for each represented plot-season, retaining the shared values and the complete group list in each row. The existing complete primary key identifies each row; configuration references select that key and a data field. Describe processed fields, their source basis and processing reasons in ai_comments; retain detailed inputs in lineage. Configurations select these data through cell references. Supply paired layer boundaries for layer data; leave both blank for aggregate or profile-wide data.
Rejects: Dated observations; route them to Soil_layer_observations_timeseries. Missing plot-season context; duplicate full primary keys; invalid layer boundaries when present; configuration selection records in place of data.
